thread.document:
For the special participation A on HW2, I use Grok to address the non-coding analytical problems 1, 2 and 7. Gemini did it great as expected, all questions were correct on the first-shot prompt. I used images as the prompt instead of the direct text.

Summary: Gemini 3 is one of the models for math questions and it doesn't disappoint, every procedure was at least acceptable, understandable and most important correct (doesn't hallucinate with these questions). The answers were correct and also using different notations.
